decks.notes: This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells, while also utilizing graveyard interaction and card advantage to maintain pressure. By combining powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief with efficient removal like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, the deck can quickly close out games. The inclusion of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Undying Evil adds resilience and versatility to the strategy, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize. Overall, this deck focuses on maintaining a strong board presence and disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The main concept of the deck is to establish early control over the game by utilizing hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using cards like Field of Ruin to destroy key lands and Karn, the Great Creator to shut down artifacts. Additionally, the deck focuses on generating mana advantage with cards like Cabal Coffers and March of Wretched Sorrow to eventually overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters, while disrupting their game plan with Thoughtseize, Terminate, and Dauthi Voidwalker. With a mix of hand disruption, removal, and efficient threats, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and close out games quickly. Additionally, cards like Grief and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional disruption and card advantage to keep the opponent on their back foot. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast and proactive game plan to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, supported by efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. Counterspells such as Spell Pierce and Counterspell help protect your threats while cards like Preordain and Expressive Iteration maintain card advantage and selection. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt opponents with counterspells, and close out the game swiftly with evasive threats. The land base is streamlined for consistent mana production and the inclusion of Mishra's Bauble adds additional card filtering and synergy with cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana with cards like Search for Tomorrow and Sakura-Tribe Elder to quickly play powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The goal is to control the board using removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Wrenn and Six, while constantly searching for the key card, Scapeshift, which allows the player to win the game by sacrificing lands and fetching multiple Valakuts. The deck also utilizes cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The One Ring to accelerate the combo. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with damage.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game through a combination of discard spells, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also generating card advantage with Sign in Blood and Cling to Dust. It also utilizes powerful end-game threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game. The deck also includes mana acceleration in the form of Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to help cast its higher cost spells.

The deck aims to ramp up quickly using land-based abilities and Amulet of Vigor to get Primeval Titan into play as soon as possible. Once Primeval Titan is on the battlefield, it can fetch key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal damage, or bounce lands like Golgari Rot Farm for additional ramp. The deck also includes utility lands like Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion and Vesuva for added flexibility. The main goal is to assemble a powerful board state that can quickly overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures with disruptive spells to put pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently. By combining powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while dealing consistent damage. Additionally, the inclusion of Thoughtseize and Grief allows for further disruption and hand manipulation, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. Overall, the deck's goal is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy while controlling the opponent's resources.

The deck focuses on using 4/5c Control to manipulate and control the board, utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Teferi, Time Raveler and Omnath, Locus of Creation. Bringing key cards to light and utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and other control elements helps to stabilize the board and set up for game-winning plays, while also utilizing powerful sideboard cards like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to further control the game.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Heliod, Sun-Crowned and Spike Feeder to create an infinite life gain loop. Ranger-Captain of Eos helps find the combo pieces, while Auriok Champion provides protection and Utopia Sprawl accelerates mana production. Collected Company is used to dig for combo pieces and Grist, the Hunger Tide provides additional value. The deck aims to win the game through gaining infinite life and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures. This combo-centric strategy requires careful sequencing and planning to execute effectively.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment combo with Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to quickly deal massive damage to the opponent. By tutoring for the pieces with Stoneforge Mystic and utilizing Urza's Saga to create more artifacts, the deck can ensure a fast and consistent win condition. The inclusion of Memnite, Ornithopter, and Inkmoth Nexus allows for quick deployment of threats and evasion. The deck also features ways to protect its combo pieces with Mana Tithe and Sigarda's Aid, making it difficult for opponents to disrupt the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to quickly put out powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and generate tokens with Crashing Footfalls. By constantly cascading into more spells and controlling the board with cards like Subtlety, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays while also disrupting their game plan with counter magic and removal spells. The diverse mana base allows for flexible casting options while Leyline Binding helps to protect key cards and maintain board presence. This high tempo strategy is designed to quickly close out games before the opponent can respond effectively.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to cheat out powerful creatures such as Curator of Mysteries and Shardless Agent, while also filling up the graveyard with creatures like Grief and Street Wraith. The ultimate goal is to cast Living End to bring back all the creatures from the graveyard, overwhelming the opponent with a board full of creatures. With support cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety to protect the combo, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively by using the combo potential of Cascade with Living End.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and aggression, aiming to quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of early threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also utilizes graveyard synergy with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death to maintain pressure on the opponent. Blood Moon is included to disrupt non-basic land strategies, while Fatal Push and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional removal and late-game reach.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cast Living End from the graveyard, while also disrupting opponents' hands with cards like Grief and Architects of Will. Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries help cycle through the deck, while Force of Negation provides protection. The creatures in the deck, such as Striped Riverwinder and Shardless Agent, help maintain board presence. The land base includes a mix of shock lands and fetch lands for consistency. The goal is to quickly ramp up and overwhelm opponents with a big board presence after resolving Living End.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing low-cost, high-impact creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate card advantage and pressure, the deck aims to finish the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Undying Evil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allow for resilience and recursion, ensuring that the aggression doesn't let up even if the opponent manages to answer some threats.
